description: ROBOTIS's tabletop robot arm: five XM430-W350 servos (four arm joints plus the gripper), 380 mm of reach, run from a PC or an OpenCR over a TTL multidrop bus. It has no onboard battery — a 12 V DC supply powers it. Values are from the ROBOTIS e-Manual specification page; link masses from the official URDF.
name: openmanipulator-x

nodes.label: 12 V DC power supply
nodes.req_label: 12.0 V input per the e-Manual specification — no onboard battery

nodes.label: OpenCR / PC controller
nodes.req_label: main controller per the e-Manual (PC or OpenCR)

nodes.label: XM430-W350-T servos (×5)
nodes.req_label: 4 arm joints + gripper, TTL multidrop bus

wiring.note: The OpenManipulator-X has no battery: the documented pattern is a 12 V DC supply feeding the controller (PC or OpenCR), which powers the five XM430-W350-T servos over the TTL multidrop bus — the bus carries both power and data on the same chain. Voltages are the e-Manual's specified 12 V input throughout.
